pre_exposure_known: GOV.UK 2018 Ashraf PEDL working paper PDF and abstract state randomized factory workers into private vs public monthly performance feedback, control receives own output; result direction (public lower relative private) and social-network mechanism already visible BEFORE THIS PREREG, so cannot be held-out. 2018 PDF first page says AEA RCT registry AEARCTR-0000981 registered Dec 17 2015. 2022 same-cohort revision abstract also seen; no new statistical outcome from these documents is confirmatory.
A: Independent original primary REGISTRY, not a further paper or simulation. Did public AEA registry AEARCTR-0000981 contain baseline friendship network subgroup, surprise sign, public-vs-private rank design and productivity outcome planned prior to first human treatment? Audit time ordering and variable provenance, differentiate planning vs posthoc mechanism claims. Unit registration VERSION and field, no human row.

B.H1: Original initial pre-trial registry public archived version predates intervention, explicitly fixes public/private rank arms, baseline friendship heterogeneity, signed rank surprise and objective productivity outcome; full claims can be assessed confirmatorily.
B.H0: Registry absent, posted after start, only generic intervention or missing friend/subgroup estimands; then social-conformity mechanism claimed by paper may be exploratory despite randomized treatment assignment.
rivals: Paper author says trial preregistered; presence of an ID need not mean subgroup analyses prespecified.
A registry updated after fieldwork must not be treated as the initial plan.
Small single factory and separate rank reference groups imply external/estimand limits.

sources.independent_registry: AEARCTR-0000981 official AEA RCT Registry initial registration and visible trial history (not abstract snippet)

primary_endpoints: Is original AEA registration accessible via official registry and dated before intervention?
Does initial archived registration explicitly pre-specify friendship network interaction and private surprise sign?
Does original registry define productivity outcome/arms without post-trial modifications?
falsifiers: Registry not accessible / no history -> BLOCKED, no cycle
Public registry lacks detail -> bounded NEGATIVE registry corroboration but do not allege researcher fraud
Any initial date AFTER treatment -> significant time-ordering red flag

D.analysis_type: read-only original registry historical metadata, no custom statistical code, code_sha_NOT_APPLICABLE
D.source_pin: AEARCTR-0000981 ID and original URL recorded at freeze, exact public version checks after prereg
D.unblinded_outcomes: 2018 and 2022 paper abstracts known pilot and posthoc, not scientific held-out

E: After THIS GitHub prereg commit, browse original AEA trial page and historical versions; record exact URLs, first publication date, intervention start, visible text and attachments, no authors contacted. Check registry revision history not current page alone. If lacks metadata or inaccessible, do not count.
F: Strictly distinguish registered trial from prespecified social network subgroup and actual human data access. No participant microdata copied or transformed. No new causal PFL effect inferred.
G: Competent comparator primary 2018 study + 2022 changed interpretation, held-out registry version distinguishes exploratory vs prespecified explanation; mere abstract reading not new cycle.
H: New prior on registry status ONLY if primary documentary evidence discriminates or falsifies expected prespec; never inflate PFL scientific novelty.
I: PFL CT2 20/100 ordinal grade 0/3 N1–N3 0/0/0 release gates 0/6 unless new direct PFL human effect independent; a source validation does not establish such effect.
J: Count at most one bounded AB-R C37 if genuine original registry history is accessed and a predeclared registration detail materially distinguishes claims; otherwise preserve all five new authorized slots, archive NOT_COUNTED attempt.
